name: GPT with Taste
description: 把 NB-Corp/gpt-with-taste 的行为配方做成 EnsoCode 预设：少确认、少防御性措辞、把子代理结果消化成行动。主会话追加 Main 与 Steer，子代理可选 taste:sub / taste:independent。每天自动同步上游。

agentTypes.name: taste:sub
agentTypes.description: Delegated agent working from the main session's brief under GPT with Taste: owns its assigned slice, makes ordinary decisions itself, and returns results the parent can act on directly.

agentTypes.name: taste:independent
agentTypes.description: Independent agent under GPT with Taste for self-contained work or a second opinion; no parent steering.
